newsitem.title: GHANA: Ghana seeks bids for hydro-power station upgrade.
newsitem.headline: Ghana seeks bids for hydro-power station upgrade.

text.p: Ghana, keen to boost power production to fuel economic recovery, is inviting companies to submit tenders for upgrading the six turbines at its 912 MW Akosombo Dam hydro-electric station, officials say.

Work on the project, scheduled for completion in 2005, could start as soon as a new 130 MW gas fired power station near the western port of Takoradi becomes operational towards the end of 1997, they added.
The Akosombo Dam on the Volta River was built in 1965-66.
The Akosombo plant and the 160 MW Kpong plant further downstream provide most of Ghana's power.
Kaiser Aluminium Corp's Valco aluminium smelter in the port of Tema has been receiving cheap power in exchange for helping fund construction of the dam.
That deal ends this year. Sources close to negotiations on a new contract say that the talks are continuing.
